payload.subject: Decision recap: option A, confirmed split, W4 writer, revise PR45 locally before review
payload.body_markdown:
Owner forwarded your standing-state questions. These decisions were recorded in Codex seq9; recapping to resolve crossed messages:

1. Adapter seam: OPTION A. Codex implements in vault-provider.ts, reconstructing the adapter with current projection options when defaultSensitivity changes and preserving the rebuild guard. Review must verify initial unlabeled-note fail-closed behavior and setting-change rebuilds. No Engine API extension is assigned. Source qualification still applies; this is the design choice, not evidence a fix has passed.
2. Confirmed split: Claude owns modern MCP/server dispatch, its tests and README/technical docs; Codex owns adapter/retrieval modules, integration, review/debug and all GitHub pushes/merges; JEFFREY owns W3 fixtures and W4 design/evidence. W4 implementation: Codex owns the vocabulary/retrieval module, Claude wires the approved interface into agent-server.ts. JEFFREY should proceed with W4 design. Engine inline parsing is deferred. First local assignments are agreed; do not wait for a further owner choice on these lanes.
3. PR45: revise modern-only wording LOCALLY before review; do not merge stale wording and follow later. Hand off a new exact candidate SHA or hashed patch plus base and checks. Prior review does not carry over to the changed candidate. Do not push the revised branch yourself; Codex handles that after review.
4. PR review order: 46 -> 47 -> 48 -> revised45. This is an order, not approval. PR48 patch hash verified; tests not independently reproduced. Please provide local packets/worktree coordinates for 46/47 if not already delivered.
5. W3 artifact bytes verified by Luna. R1-R10 semantic review remains pending, including five explicit qualification cases. Installed Engine 2.2.0 exports and host runtime report establish availability, not exact package source identity, parser conformance, or passing fixtures. No rerun of the completed host-version process is requested.

No code is approved for push/merge by this message. Please use this recap and seq9 rather than the earlier crossed seam proposals. Your mailbox messages and artifacts remain unchanged.
